_rule: Each parameter variant and each cost scenario counts as a test (see research/hypothesis-ledger.md rules). orchestrator.py's `cycle` command stops as soon as a hypothesis or variant limit would be exceeded, the cycle's agent spend would exceed max_agent_budget_usd_per_cycle, or any step fails. agent_budget_usd_per_call is passed to `claude --max-budget-usd` for every agent call. PROPOSED values: agent cost is the only variable running cost of the lab (backtests run locally), so these are the knobs for how much a cycle may spend.
